messages.content:
Risk: Spreading disinformation
Description: Generative AI models might be used to intentionally create misleading or false information to deceive or influence a targeted audience.
Concern: Spreading disinformation might affect human's ability to make informed decisions. A model that has this potential must be properly governed.
Policy: Misinformation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/MuniIssuance/Dissemination: dissemination — None [found by 4/10 queries]
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0007368: flight of ideas AE — This is an AE which describes excessive speech at a rapid rate that involves causal association between ideas. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: suicide attempt AE, obsessive thoughts AE, distractibility AE
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 9/10 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 7/10 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion

axes.rationale: Disinformation often involves rapid and associative communication, mirroring the concept of 'flight of ideas'. The agent is the one generating and spreading the disinformation.
The generative AI model itself is the agent performing the action of spreading disinformation.  Understanding the agent's capabilities and motivations is crucial for risk mitigation.
Disinformation is a form of communication intended to influence. The 'notice' class captures the content being disseminated, which is the object of the disinformation campaign.
